In right triangle RST, angle T is the right angle, RT = 20, and RS = 29. What is the value of tan(S)?
Answer choices: A) 20/29, B) 21/29, C) 20/21, D) 21/20
output.structure: right triangle with hypotenuse and one leg given; find tangent of the angle opposite the given leg

result.detail: tan(S) = opposite/adjacent = RT/ST
By Pythagorean theorem ST = \sqrt{29^2-20^2}=21, so tan(S)=20/21
